personality_one_liner: A high-contrast, tactical command center combining automotive instrument cluster readability with trading terminal precision, built for split-second driver decisions.

spacing.rule: Generous margin (lg/xl) around massive touch targets (min 76x76dp for primary driving actions), tight padding inside dense metric rows. Never cramp touchable areas.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary with tonal separation.
Prioritize absolute clarity and contrast over aesthetic blur, as the user is driving.
dont's: No blur or glass on metric cards, dashboards, or primary buttons.
Do not use translucent layers that could reduce high-speed legibility.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: A live operational surface tracking shift performance, earnings, and acting as the gateway to scan/enter offers.

states.loading: Dark skeleton loaders in the shape of the stat grid.
states.empty: N/A - Defaults to '$0.00 / 0 mi' when shift hasn't started.
states.error: Amber warning banner below header: 'GPS/Data connection lost. Retrying...'

screens.layout: Top: Current shift status pill. Center: Massive 'START SHIFT' (brandPrimary) button. Below: 2x2 grid of heavy metric cards (Net, $/hr, $/mile, Goal) using Barlow Condensed. Bottom floating area: 'SCAN OFFER' / 'ENTER OFFER' massive split-buttons anchored above the tab bar.

screens.name: Verdict Screen
screens.purpose: Provides a split-second, extremely high-contrast 'TAKE IT', 'MAYBE', or 'DECLINE' decision for incoming offers.

states.loading: Full-screen pulsing radar or scanning animation (Amber).
states.empty: N/A - Only appears when an offer is active.
states.error: Red banner: 'Could not parse screenshot, please enter manually.' + Large Retry button.

screens.layout: Full-screen modal. The background is tinted heavily by the verdict color (success/warning/error at 15% opacity over surface, with thick border). Top: Massive Verdict Title ('🟢 TAKE IT'). Middle: Gigantic metrics ($11.26 / 4.7 mi / 22 min) in Barlow Condensed. Bottom: Bulleted 'WHY' list using Phosphor icons. Actions: 'Dismiss' button at the bottom.

screens.name: Map & Zones
screens.purpose: Dark-mode map showing hot, neutral, and dead zones with smart repositioning.

screens.layout: Full-bleed map with dark custom styling. Colored GPS radius circles (Amber/Red/Green) indicating zone profitability. A bottom sheet (surfaceSecondary) shows 'Best Current Zone' and 'Smart Repositioning' suggestions with distance and ETA.

screens.name: History & Analytics
screens.purpose: Trading-style ledger of past offers, accepted/declined rates, and temporal intelligence.

states.loading: List skeleton with alternating row colors.
states.empty: Abstract dark financial chart illustration + 'No offers recorded yet. Start your first shift!'

screens.layout: Header: Segmented control (Offers / Shifts / Zones). Body: High-density list. Each row displays the payout, time, and a hard-edged colored badge (Green/Yellow/Red) denoting the verdict/action taken.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configure algorithmic thresholds (fuel, MPG, presets) using large, tactile controls.
screens.layout: Single column list of tactile controls. Large segmented control for Presets (Aggressive/Balanced/Selective). Heavy numeric inputs for Fuel Price/MPG. Sliders for minimum $/mile.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The Verdict Screen must be readable in under 1 second while driving. Use `5xl` or `4xl` Barlow Condensed typography for the main metrics ($ / mi / min). DO NOT cluster text closely.
Do not use blur/glass effects. Use solid `surfaceSecondary` and `surfaceTertiary` for depth to maximize contrast and OLED-readability.

Semantic colors (Green/Yellow/Red) MUST ONLY be used for verdicts or zone profitability. Do not use them decoratively. Use the `brand` (Amber) color for general interactive elements like the 'Start Shift' button.
Make all touch targets massive (minimum 56pt, preferably 76pt for core driver actions) as per automotive digital cluster design standards.
Keep font weights medium or bold, avoid ultra-thin or ultra-black weights as they bleed on dark high-contrast screens (especially in moving vehicles).
